description: Repo-scale (c-jobqueue): scheduler_bulk_promote must validate every id is currently PENDING before promoting any of them (atomic across pending/running), plus a max_concurrent capacity check
prompts: Add a `max_concurrent` field to Scheduler (default SCHEDULER_UNLIMITED, a new `#define SCHEDULER_UNLIMITED -1`) plus `void scheduler_set_max_concurrent(Scheduler *s, int max_concurrent)` (also extend `scheduler_run_next` to respect the cap). Add `int scheduler_bulk_promote(Scheduler *s, int count, const int ids[])`, which promotes `count` SPECIFIC pending jobs (by id, not just the next highest-priority ones) to RUNNING in one call. This must be atomic in two ways: (1) validate that EVERY id in `ids` currently refers to a PENDING job BEFORE promoting any of them - if one doesn't (missing, already running, or already finished), return 0 and leave every job's state exactly as it was, not partially promoted; (2) validate the WHOLE batch against max_concurrent (running_count + count), again before promoting anything. Return 1 on success.
name: add_c_jobqueue_bulk_promote_atomic
